scientific_boundary: The defect-weighted recursion and seed/lift decomposition are exact at every depth. The complexity-27 gap-222 census and three-defect synchronized/full pattern are finite and do not prove an all-depth three-defect bound or adjacent-shadow inclusion.

theorem.exact_recursion: For x=4q+d, recursively lift each weighted concrete shadow p of q to 4p+d exactly when the lift exists and the new current fiber is contained in the new shadow fiber; add one iff the new shadow fiber is not 1111.
theorem.seed_lift_decomposition: Every depth-L certificate is a depth-one seed followed by L-1 exact common-digit lifts, with defect equal to the sum of local non-full shadow-fiber indicators.
theorem.weighted_belief: The weighted belief retains each concrete dominant shadow endpoint together with its exact non-1111 shadow-fiber count.
